messages:
maria: ACME reported an out-of-order backfill this morning; our billing console shows small negative adjustments for a few customers. Can we triage?

omar: Thanks Maria. Are there sample events? suspect replay without a consistent replay_id.

acme-ing-engineer: apologizing — our retry logic created new event_ids on 429 and we replayed ~1.2k rows. sample: `{
customer_id: C-777, usage: 450, ts: 2026-05-10T04:00:00Z, event_id: evt-x123}`

katie: If they changed event_id on retry our event_id dedupe fails. we should short-term require X-Replay-Id header for bulk uploads and reject otherwise.

claire: From reconciliation: 5 customers affected, net negative credits total ~2,900 units. I'll open an exception ticket and run a dry reconcile.

billing-ops-bot: EX-2026-590 created and assigned to @claire. SLA 36h.

claire: Dry-run queued. Need partner CSV mapping replay_event_id -> original_event_id to match ledger. @acme-ing-engineer can you provide?

acme-ing-engineer: sending CSV to Claire now and disabling the backfill. We'll update client to preserve event_id and add X-Replay-Id.

sam: I'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb for Support: apology, impact (billing portal shows temporary credits), and ETA for fixes. Posting to #support-drafts after Claire confirms numbers.

omar: Katie, can you scope the ingest guard? Block replay uploads without X-Replay-Id for the next 24h and surface a clear 422 error with guidance. Also add a replay-rate alert.

katie: On it. Small PR to reject missing header and log partner-replay-window. ETA 90 minutes.

claire: Dry-run complete. 5 customers, over-credit 2,900 units. Applying manual reversals with audit IDs and attaching to EX-2026-590. Will keep ticket open 48h for verification.

maria: Thanks all. Please update Partner Integration Spec to make replay_id mandatory and include curl examples. Scheduling a 30m follow-up with ACME PM to agree on replay contract.
